snippet.title: The Bleakest Keep | First Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3231520/The_Bleakest_Keep/
Twitter/X: https://x.com/CacheOfBones

The Bleakest Keep is a challenging action horror roguelike. Survive the horrors of the keep and upgrade your gear as you ascend the tower and save the world!

This is my new indie game following up Slay the Minotaur! If you are a fan of horror and action, and obviously roguelikes, please go wishlist and follow the game on Steam! It should release sometime this summer! Keep your eyes peeled for a demo in the future as well! Thank you for all your support!
#roguelike #roguelite #indiegame
